regime_context: US market: Memory/HBM & Storage leads with strong score and high breadth, followed by AI Infrastructure; the rotation is broad (25/49 eligible) and not one-narrative. The absolute-trend gate has validated risk-control value here (gate_helps=true), but cross-sectional rank is an attention lens only — so these are trend-discipline reads, not return forecasts.
emerging_watch: Watch whether AI Infrastructure (rank 2, score 1.745, challenger margin 0.595 vs leader) closes half the leader gap while Memory/HBM's breadth drops below 0.6 — a confirmed handoff would retire this watch. No call until that happens.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Top-ranked eligible theme with the highest momentum score, high breadth (0.75) and a healthy durability bar (0.68). It is not crowded (z=0.53), so the trend gate is the only active discipline. Lean is to continue participating in the existing trend — not a prediction of further gains, just a vol-aware stay-with-the-leader posture.
theses.dissent: Memory is a highly cyclical sub-industry; the dramatic lead (score 2.34 vs 1.745 challenger) can compress quickly on any sign of inventory build, and 'mixed' Hurst means the trend is not clean.

falsifier.text: SMH underperforms SPY by 8% or more over any rolling 10-day window within the next 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Strong trend health (hurst 'trend', breadth 0.9, durability 0.76) but flagged CROWDED (z=1.82). Crowding is only a size-down caution, never a fade — so the honest lean here is to avoid adding exposure at this extension, not to short. The theme is eligible and scorable via CIBR, so it remains a legitimate candidate for a later pullback.
theses.dissent: Momentum is persistent; in trending regimes crowding flags often stay high while price keeps advancing, so avoiding may forfeit continued upside.

falsifier.text: CIBR outperforms SPY by 5% or more over the next 30 trading days without a crowding reversion (z dropping below 1.0).

theses.subject: AI Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Highest durability bar in the top ranks (0.85) with a 'trend' Hurst tag and standout breadth (0.917), and not crowded (z=0.69). This is the strongest staying-power leg among eligible themes — a vol-aware trend candidate where the validated drawdown-control gate is most supportive.
theses.dissent: Heavily correlated with Memory/HBM (same SMH proxy and category) — the 'diversification' here is thin; a single semiconductor de-rating hits both theses at once.

falsifier.text: SMH's 20-day realized volatility rises above 40% annualized and price underperforms SPY by 10% within the next 30 trading days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
